title: lootframe
summary: MSUI's loot window is a close counterpart of current Benilla's: the 256x256 UI-LootPanel at the left UIPanel seat, quality-colored rows, synthesized coin row, 4-row/3+pager law, minimize close, shared item tooltips plus the coin row's white classic SetText tooltip, click/autoloot wire, and client-authoritative auto-release are present. LootFrameUiLaw owns the complete exact host, portrait/title, 41-pixel row chain, row plate/icon/name/count/hit geometry, icon-relative tooltip seat, pager, close art/hitbox, and row modifier decision fork; the renderer contains no locally authored Vector2 geometry or raw ImGui tooltip. The title and wrapped, vertically centered 93x38 item-name box use GameFontNormal, while stack counts use NumberFontNormal at the exact item-button count seat. LootLatchLaw separately owns the response handshake: a warm matching latch admits any successful type, a cold latch admits only server-started types 2/3/4, and a refused success is bounced with CMSG_LOOT_RELEASE while clearing the old latch. Accepted sessions retain their target latch until the guid-matched release/refusal path. Corpse sends and local OPEN_LOCK SPELL_GO chest impacts arm the latch before the response. CharacterRenderer holds Loot animation 50 only for a stationary unmounted player whose target passes the exact predicate: dead unit and non-type-17 GameObject kneel; live units, fishing nodes, items and unresolved targets do not; movement outranks the pose and release returns directly to the normal selector. Ctrl previews a resolved item, Shift inserts its quality-colored classic link only into an open chat edit, Alt suppresses the take, modified linkless/coin rows are inert, and either unmodified mouse button loots. Quest and Loot share one bounded chat insertion path and one classic item-link grammar. The law also freezes the exact Lua-owned OnShow fork: empty loot plays LOOTWINDOWOPENEMPTY with the corpse overlay; non-empty fishing loot plays FISHING REEL IN and swaps to FishingLoot-Icon; ordinary non-empty loot remains silent because its sound is C-side and current Benilla intentionally does not guess a kit. Focused LootFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: No loot-window sounds (reference LootFrame_OnShow plays per-loot-type open kits, e.g. LOOTWINDOWOPENEMPTY); Program.Loot.cs has no PlaySound calls
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: exact current LootFrame_OnShow empty/fishing sound precedence is implemented through LootFrameUiLaw; ordinary loot intentionally stays silent exactly as current Benilla's Lua adapter does.

openItems.text: Skull overlay is static corpse art only - fishing loot icon swap not modeled (same reduction Benilla notes for itself)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: non-empty loot type 3 now selects Interface\LootFrame\FishingLoot-Icon; every other branch resets to TargetDead.

openItems.text: Loot rows only support left-click take and Ctrl-preview; current Benilla also Shift-posts item links, suppresses takes for any Ctrl/Shift/Alt modifier, keeps linkless coin rows inert under modifiers, and treats unmodified right-click as a normal take.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: LootFrameUiLaw now owns the exact modifier precedence and classic item-link payload. Ctrl previews, Shift posts only to an open chat edit, Alt and unresolved/linkless modified rows are inert, and either unmodified mouse button takes the row. Quest/Loot now share the same 255-character chat insertion and UiTextMarkup item-link grammar. Focused LootFrame, QuestLog, and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: MSUI opens every successful SMSG_LOOT_RESPONSE and immediately clears its pending target; current Benilla admits only a matching warm latch or cold server-started types 2/3/4, bounces rejected success packets with CMSG_LOOT_RELEASE, and retains the accepted target until release.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: LootLatchLaw now owns response admission, guid-matched clear, and the target-kind kneel predicate. ApplyLootResponse refuses and releases cold corpse/mismatched successes, admits matching or type-2/3/4 sessions, and retains the accepted guid. Corpse sends and local OPEN_LOCK SPELL_GO arm before the response; CharacterRenderer holds Loot 50 while stationary for dead units and non-bobber GameObjects, with movement outranking and release clearing immediately. Focused LootFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: LootFrame hand-picked generic ImGui fonts for its title, item names, and stack counts; long names were neither wrapped nor clipped to the authored 93x38 GameFontNormal box.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: LootFrameUiLaw now owns the GameFontNormal title/name and NumberFontNormal count identities, the exact name/count FontString boxes, wrapping, clipping, and vertical line-block centering. Loot behavior and protocol paths are unchanged. Focused LootFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Loot item tooltips followed the mouse instead of the authored ANCHOR_RIGHT,-123,0 seat that places them beside the 37px icon rather than the 160px row edge.
openItems.resolution: LootFrameUiLaw now owns the icon-relative tooltip anchor and bottom-left pivot. Resolved item tooltips land at the row icon's top-right; loot actions, links, content, and preserved tooltip presentation remain unchanged. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Current Benilla applies the same icon-relative owner seat to every Loot row and uses white GameTooltip:SetText for coin piles, while MSUI only offered a tooltip when an item template resolved and therefore left the synthesized coin row silent on hover.
openItems.resolution: LootFrameUiLaw now exposes the shared row tooltip seat. Coin rows publish their formatted money name as one typed white SetText line through the owner-anchored classic GameTooltip adapter; item rows retain their prepared rich tooltip on the same exact seat. Focused LootFrame and GameTooltip checks pin the split and ban raw ImGui tooltip fallback.
